draw_rule: Exclude entire upstream source document if any clause exactly matches historical classification text or is a casefold/whitespace-normalized substring of prior ContractNLI retrieval corpus. Deterministic augmenting-path matching allocates24 unique documents per task (96 distinct total), task order by eligible-document count then name; document adjacency sorted by first text-only SHA256 draw key; choose first row per assigned document without cross-document query-text duplication. No label stratification, prediction or model outcome used.
prompt_mode: Official task base_prompt template, zero-shot typed two-choice adaptation; no examples or label-dependent prompt edits.
why_amended: After source inspection, strengthen global document disjointness beyond initial text uniqueness. Both protocol versions precede all model inference; no benchmark outcomes exist for this set.
zero_shot_adaptation: Official base_prompt first paragraph only + Answer Yes or No; state is verbatim test clause; choice criteria exact Yes/No. The upstream8 in-context demonstrations are omitted, explicitly not the official few-shot protocol.
